run_nli_prediction: run get_prediction to classify a premise and hypothesis pair as entailment, neutral, or contradiction
run_snli_evaluation: run the main block to evaluate an NLI model accuracy on the SNLI dev dataset
test_get_prediction: test get_prediction with a premise and hypothesis to verify NLI classification output
review_get_prediction: review get_prediction to understand how it tokenizes input pairs and computes softmax probabilities
summarize_get_prediction: summarize get_prediction which returns predicted probabilities and class index for NLI tasks
